entities.summary: Kasing Lung is a Hong Kong illustrator and toy designer best known as the creator of Labubu, sold by the brand Pop Mart, which he originally introduced as a character in his series The Monsters. Lung has achieved global recognition with his release of over 300 different versions of the Labubu character. Inspired by folklore and Nordic myths, his work includes figurative toy designs, paintings and solo exhibitions.
